en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from someone else from his companions, from Aban Bin Usman, from one of his companions,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the child, when he becomes a youth, so he chooses the Christianity, and one of his parents is a Christian, or they are both Muslims. He<sup>asws</sup> Said: ‘He would not be left, but he would be whipped upon Al-Islam’.
